# soapysdr-module-osmosdr

**SoapySDR driver module for OsmoSDR and MiriSDR hardware**

- **Version recorded:** 0.2.5
- **Categories:** `hardware`, `sdr`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/pothosware/SoapyOsmo/wiki>

## What it does

Makes the devices supported by the OsmoSDR driver library usable through SoapySDR, so SoapySDR software sees them without needing OsmoSDR-specific code.

## Why you would want it

Only if you have the hardware. Do not confuse it with `gr-osmosdr`, which is the GNU Radio block that reaches many different devices -- the names are close and the two do quite different jobs. This is a device driver shim; that is a framework block.

## Before it will work

OsmoSDR hardware and its driver library, which apt pulls in.

## How it installs

- apt: `soapysdr-module-osmosdr`

## Known problems

The hardware was never widely produced and the software around it is maintained rather than developed. Debian built this and `soapysdr-module-rfspace` from the same `soapyosmo` source package until 0.2.5-9 (2025-10-21) disabled the RFSpace module; from then on this one ships everywhere and the RFSpace one only where the older source remains.

## Keeping it current

- probe: apt policy
- strategy: apt_upgrade

The Pothosware project.
